name: popsicle
headline: Lead Generation Strategies Using SMO
short_description: Explore effective strategies for lead generation through social media optimization (SMO), including SEO, content advertising, and email marketing to enhance brand awareness and drive traffic.
author: bitsenzes

sections.overview:
This skill covers comprehensive lead generation techniques centered on social media optimization and digital marketing strategies. It explains how to use SEO, content advertising, inbound marketing, social media marketing, PPC, marketing automation, and email marketing to attract and convert prospects. The skill details how each method—from search engine optimization to email campaigns—drives organic traffic and generates leads. It also introduces tools like Growbots, InsideView, and Leadfeeder that automate lead lookup and targeting, reducing manual effort while improving lead quality and conversion potential.
Developing a social media campaign for lead generation
Optimizing website content for higher search rankings
Automating email marketing campaigns to nurture leads
